summary_en: This study tests proton-spatially fractionated radiotherapy (P-SFRT) given with standard radiation therapy (IG-IMRT) in adults with newly diagnosed retroperitoneal soft tissue sarcoma. Patients receive one P-SFRT treatment, then IG-IMRT over 25 to 28 fractions across 35 to 42 days, followed by surgical removal of the tumor 21 to 35 days after radiation. This is a Phase 1/Phase 2 trial; the record does not state a specific main outcome, but it names side effects, best dose, and how well the treatment works.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radioterapia espacialmente fraccionada con protones (P-SFRT) administrada junto con la radioterapia estándar (IG-IMRT) en adultos con sarcoma de tejidos blandos retroperitoneal de diagnóstico reciente. Los pacientes reciben una sesión de P-SFRT, luego IG-IMRT en 25 a 28 fracciones durante 35 a 42 días, seguida de la extirpación quirúrgica del tumor entre 21 y 35 días después de la radiación. Es un ensayo de Fase 1/Fase 2; el registro no indica un resultado principal específico, pero menciona los efectos secundarios, la dosis óptima y qué tan bien funciona el tratamiento.
who_for: Newly diagnosed, untreated retroperitoneal soft tissue sarcoma at least 3 cm, confirmed by imaging within 30 days
Measurable disease according to RECIST version 1.1
ECOG performance status 0 or 1, or Karnofsky score above 70%
Agree to contraception if able to become pregnant or father a child
not_for: Prior radiation therapy to the affected area
Certain sarcoma subtypes where neoadjuvant chemotherapy is standard care
Chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or other anticancer agents within 14 days before planned start
Unresolved side effects above grade 1 from prior cancer treatment, except alopecia
Active tuberculosis, or active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
